v0.3.0: Smart Skill Synthesis + Learning Export + Analytics + Legal safety improvements
Major: added skill-card.md, proper ClawHub packaging

Initial release of safe-self-improving: a secure, consent-based self-improvement skill for AI agents.

- Requires explicit user confirmation before recording learnings, errors, or improvements; no auto-execution.
- All data is stored locally in a dedicated `.learnings/` directory; no uploads, no cross-session communication.
- Sensitive info is automatically sanitized before saving.
- No hooks, no automatic file modification outside `.learnings/`.
- Transparent operation with logs; privacy and security focused.
